description: This file contains test scripts for evaluating a git hook (proc-receive) in a Git project, simulating different scenarios of hook behavior and push failures.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up and triggers a test hook with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_tool proc-receive
methods.description: Runs the 'proc-receive' command with verbose output for testing.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes command output to make it more stable and user-friendly.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats output and saves expected results for comparison.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two outputs or files for equality.
